items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: You know the last time I saw him? At a birthday party when he gave four little coffee on the couch.

ctx.x: But you know the last time I saw him? You know the last time I saw him? At a birthday party when he gave four little coffee on the couch. He had a stroke. He had a very little sick. He played a bass, what you call him? Baratone. Saxophone, man. Yeah. Yeah. He was great. Yeah, he was supposed to be one of those. He used to be with Arnold all the time, always played with him. He was a fine fellow. Oh, there's so many of my guests eventually come to you.
Oh, what happened to that fellow who used to live on Prayer and Demand? He used to play with Dad.
